```{r} 
# devtools::install_github("SLesche/acdc-query")
# library(acdcquery)
library(tidyverse)

# load functions for data cleaning and plotting
source("functions.R")
```

## Data loading
```{r}
#download the ACDC (Haaf et al., 2025)
# download_acdc(dest_dir = getwd())

# connect to ACDC
db_filepath <- "acdc.db"
conn <- connect_to_db(db_filepath)

# create a list with filter arguments to select data
argument_list <- list()

# select data only from stroop tasks
argument_list <- add_argument(
  list = argument_list,
  conn = conn,
  variable = "task_name",
  operator = "equal",
  values = c("stroop")
)

# select data from all authors except Ebersole et al.
argument_list <- add_argument(
  list = argument_list,
  conn = conn,
  variable = "authors",
  operator = "notequal",
  values = "Charles R. Ebersole, Olivia E. Atherton, Aimee L. Belanger, Hayley M. Skulborstad, Jill M. Allen, Jonathan B. Banks, Erica Baranski, Michael J. Bernstein, Diane B.V. Bonfiglio, Leanne Boucher,  Elizabeth R. Brown, Nancy I. Budiman, Athena H. Cairo, Colin A. Capaldi, Christopher R. Chartier, Joanne M. Chung, David C. Cicero, Jennifer A. Coleman, John G. Conway, William E. Davis, Thierry Devos, Melody M. Fletcher, Komi German, Jon E. Grahe, Anthony D. Hermann, Joshua A. Hicks, Nathan Honeycutt, Brandon Humphrey, Matthew Janus, David J. Johnson, Jennifer A. Joy-Gaba, Hannah Juzeler, Ashley Keres, Diana Kinney, Jacqeline Kirshenbaum, Richard A. Klein, Richard E. Lucas, Christopher J.N. Lustgraaf, Daniel Martin, Madhavi Menon, Mitchell Metzger, Jaclyn M. Moloney, Patrick J. Morse, Radmila Prislin, Timothy Razza, Daniel E. Re, Nicholas O. Rule, Donald F. Sacco, Kyle Sauerberger, Emily Shrider, Megan Shultz, Courtney Siemsen, Karin Sobocko, R. Weylin Sternglanz, Amy Summerville, Konstantin O. Tskhay, Zack van Allen, Leigh Ann Vaughn, Ryan J. Walker, Ashley Weinberg, John Paul Wilson, James H. Wirth, Jessica Wortman, Brian A. Nosek"
)

# query ACDC using the specified filtering
results <- query_db(
  conn = conn,
  arguments = argument_list,
  target_vars = c(
    "default",
    "authors",
    "within_description",
    "dataset_id",
    "study_id",
    "task_name",
    "task_description",
    "study_comment"),
    target_table = c("observation_table"),
  argument_relation = "and"
)


# write_csv(
#   results,
#   file.path("acdc_stroop_data.csv")
# )
```

## Data cleaning
```{r}
enkavi <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[1]) %>%
  filter(within_id == 2) %>% # only use data from the first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

hedge <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[2]) %>%
  filter(within_id %in% c(8, 9)) %>% # only use data from the first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

löffler <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[3]) %>%
  filter(accuracy != -3 & accuracy != -2) %>%
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)
 
pratte_exp1 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[4]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 39) %>% # Experiment 1 in Pratte et al. (2010)
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)
 
pratte_exp2 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[4]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 41)  %>% # Experiment 2 in Pratte et al. (2010)
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.75)

rey_mermet1 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[5]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 42)  %>% # color stroop task, young adults
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

rey_mermet2 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[5]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 43)  %>% # numeric stroop task, young adults
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

rey_mermet3 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[5]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 46) %>% # classical color stroop task, older adults
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)
 
rey_mermet4 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[5]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 47) %>% # numeric stroop task, older adults
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

stahl <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[6]) %>%
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.75)

tang1 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[7]) %>%
  filter(within_description == "test phase; baseline session; mostly congruent set") %>% # first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

tang2 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[7]) %>%
  filter(within_description == "test phase; baseline session; PC-50 set (meaning 50% congruency)") %>% # first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

tang3 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[7]) %>%
  filter(within_description == "test phase; reactive session; mostly congruent set (100% congruent)") %>% # first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

tang4 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[7]) %>%
  filter(within_description == "test phase; reactive session; PC-50 set (meaning 50% congruency)") %>% # first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

tang5 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[7]) %>%
  filter(within_description == "test phase; reactive session; mostly incongruent set") %>% # first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

tang6 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[7]) %>%
  filter(within_description == "test phase; proactive session; PC-50 set (meaning 50% congruency)") %>% # first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

tang7 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[7]) %>%
  filter(within_description == "test phase; proactive session; mostly incongruent set") %>% # first measurement point
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

von_bastian <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[8]) %>%
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

whitehead1 <- res %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[9]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 56) %>% # data taken from Experiment 1 in Whitehead, Brewer & Blais (2019)
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)
  
whitehead2 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[9]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 59) %>% # data taken from Experiment 2 in Whitehead, Brewer & Blais (2019)
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)
  
whitehead3 <- results %>%
  filter(authors == unique(res$authors)[9]) %>%
  filter(dataset_id == 62) %>% # data taken from Experiment 3 in Whitehead, Brewer & Blais (2019)
  clean_data(accuracy_cutoff = 0.50)

datasets <- list(
  "Enkavi et al. (2019)" = enkavi,
  "Hedge et al. (2018)" = hedge,
  "Löffler et al." = löffler,
  "Pratte et al. (2010), experiment 1" = pratte_exp1,
  "Pratte et al. (2010), experiment 2" = pratte_exp2,
  "Rey-Mermet et al. (2018), color Stroop, young adults" = rey_mermet1,
  "Rey-Mermet et al. (2018), numeric Stroop, young adults" = rey_mermet2,
  "Rey-Mermet et al. (2018), color Stroop, older adults" = rey_mermet3,
  "Rey-Mermet et al. (2018), numeric Stroop, older adults" = rey_mermet4,
  "Stahl et al. (2014)" = stahl,
  "Tang et al. (2023), baseline session, mostly congruent set" = tang1,
  "Tang et al. (2023), baseline session, 50% congruency" = tang2,
  "Tang et al. (2023), reactive session, 100% congruent" = tang3,
  "Tang et al. (2023), reactive session, 50% congruency" = tang4,
  "Tang et al. (2023), reactive session, mostly incongruent set" = tang5,
  "Tang et al. (2023), proactive session, 50% congruency" = tang6,
  "Tang et al. (2023), proactive session, mostly incongruent set" = tang7,
  "von Bastian et al. (2016)" = von_bastian,
  "Whitehead et al. (2020), experiment 1" = whitehead1,
  "Whitehead et al. (2020), experiment 2" = whitehead2,
  "Whitehead et al. (2020), experiment 3" = whitehead3
)
```


## Plotting the results
### Group-level association between speed and accuracy
```{r}
for (name in names(datasets)) {
  
    if (name == "Tang et al. (2023), reactive session, 100% congruent") {
    next
    }
  
  plot <- plot_group_corr(datasets[[name]], name)
  print(plot)
}
```

### Group-level association between the effect of congruency on rt and the effect on accuracy
```{r}
for (name in names(datasets)) {
  
  if (name == "Tang et al. (2023), reactive session, 100% congruent") {
    next
    }
  
  plot <- plot_effect(datasets[[name]], name)
  print(plot)
}
``` 


### Subject-level association between speed and accuracy across sections of 20 trials
```{r}
for (name in names(datasets)) {
  
  if (name == "Tang et al. (2023), reactive session, 100% congruent") {
    next
  }
  
  plot <- plot_speed_acc_lm(datasets[[name]], name)
  print(plot)
}
```

### RT for trials with correct and incorrect answers
```{r}
for (name in names(datasets)) {
  plot <- plot_rt_acc(datasets[[name]], name)
  print(plot)
}
```

### Association between the proportion of subjects with accuracy > .99 and the sign of the correlation between speed and accuracy
```{r}
for (name in names(datasets)) {
  
  if (name == "Tang et al. (2023), reactive session, 100% congruent") {
    next
    }
  
  p <- ceiling_sign_summary(datasets[[name]], name)
  print(p)
}
```
